title: Google and Apple
article:
Google has released the new Google Pixel 9 and their new AI, Gemini. Apple then responded with iPhone 16 and with Apple Intelligence. Is there something deeper going on here or is it just a natural reaction? It all started with no Apple in the story since they were too focussed on their products at the time and becoming popular because they just started their company so it started with just Samsung and Google.

It all started with a partnership between Microsoft and Samsung to make Google mad. Why they wanted to make Google mad, is yet to be uncovered. Google ended up responding to that by partnering with Android. This is one of the biggest phone rivalries in history. Then Samsung fumbled with Touchwiz, their user interface. This is where Apple comes in. Apple filed a lawsuit against Samsung about Touchwiz. Then Samsung just abandoned Touchwiz, which was bad for their reputation. Google likes to take advantage of that and releases a new phone , it flops. Samsung responds by copying every single app by Google, almost too many to list. Samsung then didsomething undoable, they made a watch that had a design that clips on to your vanes ending up with your blood. Immediately after Google released another phone, it flopped again. Next Samsung released a highly flammable phone. Then Google immediately released a phone called Google Pixel 1, which sold amazingly. And then they bought Motorola, the phone company dumb move. Samsung had lost to Google, but Google also has a reputation for bad products.*

Anyway, Google and Apple stayed apart until Apple was planning iPhone 16 and Google came out with Gemini. Apple had been planning an AI but remember these are very different. Apples AI focused on making the product better and adding new features. Google on the other hand focused on safety and your experience. So now you can see that Apple just wants to make them the center of attention.

*This is a link to every failed Google project https://killedbygoogle.com/.
author: Asher Fine
